title: Para Bellum content: squads
description: The floor of the formation hierarchy, beside a vehicle: DIVISION > COMPANY > PLATOON > SQUAD or VEHICLE, four levels and no fifth (AD-M45). A vehicle needs no row here: a platoon names an existing design, whose crew and transport_passengers already say what it carries. File: Content/<namespace>/squad.json. Men and officers here are the only authored personnel figures in the hierarchy: a company's and a division's are derived by walking down to these rows and to vehicle crew, and are never stored, so they cannot disagree with the walk.

name.description: What the player reads. Optional for a mod, required of shipped content (C802).

men.description: Everyone in the squad, its officers included.

officers.description: How many of those men are officers. No more than men (C606).
